fields.text: Strongest feature: Bush explicitly grants consistency and rejects the tempting inference from a disturbing counterfactual to violent preferences, explaining how conflating metaethical commitments with actual normative approval would misrepresent both Adelstein and utilitarians more generally. Principal limitation: This clarification does not decide whether independent moral facts exist or possess authority, so its exceptional quality as fair interpretation should not be mistaken for new evidential support against the realist position. Live burden: Further assessment must retain the extraordinary certainty threshold and evaluate the philosophical conditional on its own terms, without turning imagined implications into psychological accusations or presenting either speaker as endorsing the harmful examples. Locked score: The retained 93 reflects outstanding calibration, direct acknowledgment of the preceding answer, and an explicit safeguard against irrelevant character inference, grounded in the actual qualifications Adelstein supplied rather than generalized politeness.
